- Yes, we can support mixed cadence. Typical pattern we recommend is monthly sweeps for the committed baseline and quarterly top-up tranches for milestone purchases. That balances predictability and bank reconciliation.
- For VAT: we can emit per-tranche invoices or a consolidated monthly invoice by legal entity. If Blue Harbor wants easier reclaiming, we advise per-entity invoices.
- PO: a master PO that references the annual commitment plus per-invoice numbers is fine for our billing team.
